definitions.explanation: A prolonged period of abnormally low rainfall, leading to a shortage of water and damage to crops.

examples.japanese: {干|かん}ばつ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{農作物|のうさくぶつ}→農作物：15271_nousakubutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{枯|か}れた→枯れる：04589_kareru⟧。
examples.english: The crops withered due to the drought.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{干|かん}ばつ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{水不足|みずぶそく}→水不足：15397_mizubusoku⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: There's a water shortage due to drought this year.

examples.japanese: {干|かん}ばつ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。

notes:
{干|かん}ばつ refers to a prolonged period without rain, causing water shortage and crop damage. Can also be written as {旱魃|かんばつ} with rare kanji, but the mixed writing {干|かん}ばつ is standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {干|かん}ばつ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: drought continues
- {干|かん}ばつ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: drought damage
- {干|かん}ばつ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{水不足|みずぶそく}→水不足：15397_mizubusoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to have water shortage due to drought
- {干|かん}ばつ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われる→見舞われる：27351_mimawareru⟧: to be hit by drought
- ⟦{記録的|きろくてき}→記録的：28788_kirokuteki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{干|かん}ばつ: record drought
